description: [OSM - GPS] Parkings vélo is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. Les stations de vélo en libre-service recensées sur le territoire de Grand Paris Sud (source OpenStreetMap). Requête Overpass: (area[name="Communauté d'agglomération Grand Paris Sud Seine Essonne Sénart"]; )-.searchArea; ( nwr"amenity"="bicycleparking"; ); (.;;); out body qt;. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are osm_export, openstreetmap, vélo, station de vélo, transport doux. The portal shows 347 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
